name: EDCI 5080
title: Reading and Literacy in the Content Areas
description: Effective use of reading and writing to help students learning content material. Includes selection of reading materials that are appropriate for individual students with diverse reading abilities, understanding reading diagnosis provided by other professionals, using reading material in ways that facilitate comprehension and learning, and using written asignments to increase understanding and recall.
requirement_description: Open to students in the Teaching Certification Program for College Graduates, others with consent.
